name: golink
description: Personal Chrome extension implementing go/ link shortcuts.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js safari/src/*.js test/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))" && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('safari/manifest.json','utf8'))" && echo OK
